content: There is a lot going on recently in Kestrel Bay right now. Can you review the larger arc and patterns, and from that can you provide any larger view of the current direction of geopolitics, focused on ports, fuel, trade and labour disputes, etc?

## Bottom line
**The Kestrel Bay arc is defined by rising patrol activity, strained fuel supply, widening licence limits, and simmering dock unrest.**

### Ports and patrols

- **Observation 1.** In this period the Kestrel Bay Port Authority suspended night berthing at Marrow Point after the Dunmere Canal locks were shut [87a897c7-7e6b-53ca-8496-e1562a3096af].
- **Observation 2.** In this period the Ostrel Fuel Cooperative rerouted three tanker convoys around the Fenwick Isles [552ef6c1-ec11-5ade-8cbf-d3476b4b79e4].
- **Observation 3.** In this period the Halden Grain Union extended its work-to-rule at the northern quays [ed7caaea-95bc-5dc6-ba4d-da8da5cc1f6b].
- **Observation 4.** In this period Vesper Shipping Line posted a surcharge of 14 percent on all Cobalt Sound crossings [9ec2cc57-ac80-5aa3-bc5a-9298d8369450].

**Judgment (0.75).** The pattern in this area is consistent with the wider Kestrel Bay picture and is best read as a managed squeeze on port access rather than a collapse of trade.

### Fuel and freight

- **Observation 5.** In this period the Veldmark coast guard doubled its patrol hours in the Grey Narrows [eaf0263c-7357-5991-bf66-fab272e9b89d].

**Judgment (0.55).** The pattern in this area is consistent with the wider Kestrel Bay picture and is best read as a managed squeeze on port access rather than a collapse of trade.

### Levies and licences

- **Observation 9.** In this period Tarn rebels seized the Cobalt Gate pier and announced a toll on passing ships [90c96113-f025-5532-8fbb-4feed5090e13].
- **Observation 10.** In this period the Sarn navy declared an exclusion zone in the Grey Narrows during live-fire drills [39d9a486-3f35-5c59-9b65-a09b5969466b].

**Judgment (0.70).** The pattern in this area is consistent with the wider Kestrel Bay picture and is best read as a managed squeeze on port access rather than a collapse of trade.

### Labour and street

- **Observation 11.** In this period dockworkers at Marrow Point voted to continue the walkout for a further week [454ca098-4146-593a-858e-5cc039004fbd].
- **Observation 12.** In this period student groups marched on the harbour board demanding the resignation of its chair [0d50d271-c26c-5300-9a32-5fb372bb5715].
- **Observation 13.** In this period the Kestrel Bay grain price index reached its highest reading of the quarter [9247f8a6-e491-5b39-94a9-0ab8b56a577f].

**Judgment (0.85).** The pattern in this area is consistent with the wider Kestrel Bay picture and is best read as a managed squeeze on port access rather than a collapse of trade.

### What could shift this assessment

- **Observation 14.** In this period an inspection backlog at Wick Port left forty vessels waiting at anchor [92cc5689-55dd-546c-92e7-580623f1f39c].
- **Observation 15.** In this period the Brindle summit produced a framework on levies but left the data-channel dispute open [fc889228-369e-5da4-87cc-42d6b2028654].
- **Observation 16.** In this period microchip cargo was held at the Marrow Point customs shed under a new licence rule [09ab2be5-bd55-5f29-b7ca-c597490b52b0].

**Judgment (0.65).** The pattern in this area is consistent with the wider Kestrel Bay picture and is best read as a managed squeeze on port access rather than a collapse of trade.
